review: 111.10d-1: base variant had a non-empty delta and the Doom Blade pair (Walker vs Grizzly Bears as target) flipped nothing about the Walker token; rewrote as Michonne attacking with two Walker tokens (Zombie count fires her trigger, 2 damage each) against two Soldier tokens.

111.10h-1: base variant had a non-empty delta, and the multi-turn setup left both libraries empty so a player would lose on drawing; started on A's later turn with the untapped Powerstone token already on the battlefield and made Giant Spider the base, Juggernaut the delta.
111.10t-1: base variant had a non-empty delta; moved the main-phase timing into the decisions and left the end-step timing as the only delta.
111.10i-1: expected omitted that Tangled Skyline gives the transformed Phyrexian reach; added it.

111.10x-1: the prepared/not-prepared pair tested the prepare mechanic, not the Heartwood definition; the pair now spends the Heartwood's mana on Giant Growth ({G}, legal) against Dark Ritual ({B}, illegal).

111.2-2: the Counterspell variant tested countering, not ownership; replaced it with B casting the same instant so the creator (and so the owner and controller) flips, and dropped Counterspell and Islands.

scenarios.title: A token is owned and controlled by the player who creates it, even when another player's permanent causes it
decisions: A casts Shock targeting B, paying {R} by tapping Forbidden Orchard for mana.
Forbidden Orchard's trigger goes on the stack targeting B (the only opponent); both players pass; the trigger resolves.
Both players pass; Shock resolves.

variants.label: orchard_tapped
variants.expected: B is the player who creates the 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token: B owns it and controls it; A controls no token. B's life is 18.

variants.label: mountain_tapped
variants.delta: A pays {R} by tapping Mountain instead of Forbidden Orchard, so no creation instruction exists.
variants.expected: Forbidden Orchard's trigger does not fire; no token is created. B's life is 18.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forbidden Orchard's Mode$ TapsForMana trigger with Activator$ You; the token is created with TokenOwner$ Targeted.

variants.expected: B creates the two Soldier tokens: B owns and controls both; A controls no token.
